# Draft:Juking (Video Game Tactic)

Juking is a type of Tactic that is done in a way that it distracts Killers that makes them go lost so the Player can run away from the Killers and some sorts.
Juking has Several Tactics a well known one on Roblox as the "360 Juke" commonly used to Trick the Killer/Enemy in game.
There are other well known ones on Roblox as Jumping which would usually Work.
Crawling can be done but it likly Depends what Game it is on Roblox.
